name: Half-time shuffle
desc: Purdie/Porcaro half-time shuffle: triplet-feel hats via elongation, backbeat snare on 3 only, ghost snares filling the shuffle pockets, feathered kick; peak opens the hats and doubles the ghost lattice.

code.full: stack(s("bd ~ [~ ~ bd] ~").bank("RolandTR909").gain(${gain}*.9).shape(.25), s("~ ~ sd ~").bank("RolandTR909").gain(${gain}*.66).lpf(3600), s("[~ ~ sd]*4").bank("RolandTR909").gain("[0 0 ${ghost}]*4").lpf(2200), s("[hh@2 hh]*4").bank("RolandTR707").gain("[.5 .26]*4").lpf(sine.range(4200,6000).slow(24)).pan(sine.range(.42,.58).slow(16))).lastOf(8, x=>x.ply(2)).room(${room}).orbit(1).play()
code.peak: stack(s("bd ~ [~ ~ bd] [~ bd ~]").bank("RolandTR909").gain(${gain}).shape(.3), s("~ ~ sd ~").bank("RolandTR909").gain(${gain}*.7).lpf(3800), s("[sd ~ sd]*4").bank("RolandTR909").gain("[${ghost} 0 ${ghost}]*4").lpf(2400), s("[hh@2 hh]*4").bank("RolandTR707").gain("[.54 .3]*4").lpf(sine.range(5000,7000).slow(16)).pan(sine.range(.4,.6).slow(12)), s("~ [~ ~ oh] ~ [~ ~ oh]").bank("RolandTR707").gain(.32), s("cr ~ ~ ~").gain(.18).lastOf(8, x=>x.gain(.28))).lastOf(8, x=>x.ply(2)).room(${room}).orbit(1).play()
